transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me a bit about what has been bothering you and what brings you in to see me today?

I've been feeling incredibly depressed, sad, and just completely empty inside for about a year and two months now. It feels like there is nothing left in me, and I'm just so tired of feeling this way. I really don't know what to do anymore.
Have you felt this way nearly every single day for the past year and two months, or have there been periods of two months or longer where you felt completely like your normal self?

I have felt this way continuously for the entire year and two months. There haven't been any periods where I felt like my normal self at all. It has just been a constant, heavy darkness every single day.

latest_inference.note: The patient reports a continuous, unremitting depressed mood for over one year (14 months), which meets the duration criteria for Persistent Depressive Disorder (Dysthymia). Given the lack of any symptom-free intervals, Persistent Depressive Disorder is a more accurate fit than Major Depressive Disorder, which is typically characterized by distinct episodes.
